title: AdvSumm: Adversarial Training for Bias Mitigation in Text Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the hallucination rate on the Wiki-Nationality dataset, which evaluates whether the summarization model incorrectly infers or assumes a person's nationality based on counterfactual name substitutions rather than the input document.

Evaluating political framing bias in generated summaries by calculating positive and negative arousal scores using a Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) lexicon on the Multi-Neus dataset, which contains left-, right-, and center-slanted news articles.
